basis: Sealed-arch (side-shell fitted) 1 CFM solution: claude-run/sealed-arch/sealed-arch-1cfm-final.cas.h5/.dat.h5 (single precision, SIMPLEC)
method: Phase A: unit-load thermal response. Energy equation enabled; flow equations frozen at the solved airflow (no buoyancy, constant properties), so temperature rise is linear in each source and any load set is a weighted sum. One energy-only solve per source with 1 W as a uniform wall heat flux over that source surface; every other wall adiabatic. Phase B (after Phase A, needs a user-chosen load set): one coupled run with gravity and Boussinesq buoyancy to measure how natural convection changes the superposed result.

pcb-front.rule: wall zone bbox inside the body bbox +/- 0.2 mm (wall-inventory.json); plus zone2:15011, the board's rear face, whose bbox reaches 0.2-0.3 mm past the body bbox (found when 300 showed half the area of the identical back board)

pcb-middle.rule: wall zone bbox inside the body bbox +/- 0.2 mm (wall-inventory.json); plus zone2:16673, the board's rear face, whose bbox reaches 0.2-0.3 mm past the body bbox (found when 300 showed half the area of the identical back board)

pcb-back.rule: wall zone bbox inside the body bbox +/- 0.2 mm (wall-inventory.json)

camera-minus-x.body: clean r 7.5 mm camera cylinder, x -40.51..-32.49 mm
camera-minus-x.rule: wall zone bbox inside the body bbox +/- 0.2 mm (wall-inventory.json)

camera-plus-x.body: clean r 7.5 mm camera cylinder, x 32.49..40.51 mm

motor.body: archived 36GY envelope: sealed cylinder r 18 mm about (x, y) = (0, 27.5) mm, z 35.2-106 mm (fluid-geometry-manifest.json)
motor.rule: manual: 25130 = cylinder side (z 37-106), 25124 = top cap exposed through the frame opening (z 106), 25127 = bottom cap exposed through the motor-mount hole (z 35.2). Excluded: 22760 (motor-mount strip), 23474 (36GY output shaft below the envelope)

camera_note: The two cameras are one source: 1 W split by area (equal areas, so 0.5 W each). Their outer ends lie outside the casing.

assumptions_not_measurements.walls: adiabatic except the source surfaces (conservative: all heat leaves with the air; no shell conduction, no radiation)
